rationale: Independently read both SAHO historical bodies: Botha formal premiership 1910–1919; Smuts succeeded on death in 1919 and lost 1924 election; Hertzog Pact government 1924 with 1929 reelection and retained premiership 1934. Interior-year claims avoid exact-day precision and stop at job 1930. Narrow office facts are compatible with existing racially restricted Dominion framework and do not imply universal consent or uniform control. Existing leaders empty and no catalogue URL duplicates.
